summary.ru: Поуис Венвинвин, или Южный Поуис — маленькое средневековое валлийское княжество, занимавшее южную часть Поуиса в 1160-1283 годах. Оно образовалось в 1160 году в результате раздела Поуиса между наследниками Мадога ап Маредида.
summary.en: Southern Powys or Powys Wenwynwyn, was a Welsh lordship which existed during the high Middle Ages. The realm was the southern portion of the former princely state of Powys which split following the death of Madog ap Maredudd and the killing of his heir Llywelyn in 1160: the northern portion (Maelor) went to Gruffydd Maelor and eventually became known as Powys Fadog; while the southern portion (Cyfeiliog) going to Owain Cyfeiliog and becoming known, eventually, as Powys Wenwynwyn after Prince Gwenwynwyn ab Owain, its second ruler.
